Reasons for Previous Ul

Women gave an average of 2.7 specific reasons for having UI in the past 3 months. Women who had fewer than three acts of Ul gave an average of 1.9 reasons: women who had more Ul gave an average of 3.0 reasons (p .05: data not shown). The most common groups of reasons for having had Ul in the 3 months before conception were that they did not think they were going to get pregnant (42%), they had trouble getting a contraceptive method (40%), and they weren't planning on having sex (38%)

(Table 2). Attitudes Toward UI

The most prevalent attitude about UI was that it "feels better or more naturalian opinion held by 48% of respondents. Just over one third (36%) said it was "okay to have once in a while or at certain times of the month" (Table 3). One in four women (28%), reported "relationship and partner reasons" to have Ul.
